body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented 8mm-thick slim mouse at KES 2006. This slim mouse measures 40 X 95 X 8mm with a wheel that moves from right to left unlike the existing mouse. With LED light, it has 5 buttons and semi-automatic cable winder. It is expected to be used for UMPC or notebook pc.
